title: Set up the receipt printer
text: Set up the receipt printer from the register. Choose the printer, match the paper size, and test it.
steps: Go to Point of Sale. The register opens.
Click More Options > Printer Setup.
On the Printers tab, select Receipt Printer and choose your printer. Add a Bluetooth or network printer by scanning or entering its IP address.
Set Paper Width to 58mm or 80mm to match the paper roll.
Click Test Print to check the receipt margins. Click Cash Drawer to test the drawer.
In Home, Turn Automatic Print on or off, then click Save Settings.

title: Register a terminal and its serial number
text: Each register uses a terminal. Set it up the first time you open the register. Sales are recorded under that terminal.
steps: Go to Point of Sale.
When asked, choose Register as new terminal and enter a name, or choose Use an existing terminal.
To rename, deactivate, or reset a terminal,In Sidebar > Go to Settings > Terminals.
To add a serial number, In Sidebar > Go to Settings > Business Details. The first number prints on BIR receipts.
Use Terminals to view reading history or move Entity from another POS.

title: Show the customer display on a second screen
text: Customer Display shows the cart and payment result on a second screen.
steps: Go to Point of Sale > More Options > Customer Display.
Move the display window to the second monitor. On Android, connect the screen with HDMI or USB-C first.
To choose a layout, go to Settings > Customer Display > Customer Display tab.
Set the cart position and size. Choose whether to show the customer name, order total, and payment confirmation.
Click Save.

title: Advertising images and videos on the customer display
text: When no sale is in progress, the customer display shows your uploaded pictures and videos.
steps: Click Sidebar >Settings > Customer Display.
Open the Advertisement Display tab.
Click Upload Advertising Files and add PNG, JPG, GIF, MP4, WebM, or MOV files.
Choose whether to rotate all files or show one file only.
Set the display time, transition, shuffle, and video sound, then click Save.

title: Change the cashier layout and theme
text: Appearance controls the theme and logo. Cashier Layout controls the register design and buttons.
steps: Go to Settings > Appearance.
Choose the theme mode, brand colour, and cashier logo.
Under Cashier Layout, choose a layout and click Customize Cashier Theme.
Adjust the buttons, cart columns, row height, totals, and shortcuts.
Click Save. To use the design in every branch, click Apply & Sync to All Branches.

title: Force cash in, cash out, and the Z cash count
text: These settings control the cashier's opening cash, cash out, and drawer counts.
steps: Go to Settings > Cashier Settings > Cash & Shift.
Turn on Force Cash In to require opening cash before selling, unless the last reading was run.
Turn on Force Cash Out to require cashing out before the End Mid (Y) reading.
Turn on Z Reading Requires Cash Count to require a drawer count before the Z reading. The Y reading always requires a count.
Click Save.

title: Cart and discount rules for the register
text: Cashier Settings controls the cart, discounts, and promotions.
steps: Go to Settings > Cashier Settings.
Turn on Merge Identical Items to combine repeated scans.
Choose whether new items appear at the top or bottom.
Turn on Ask Before Removing Product or Require Reason to Clear Cart if needed.
Set the discount type, manager approval, and discount limit.
Turn on Enable Promotions to use promotions at the register.
Click Save.

title: Stock rules at the register
text: These settings control which stock a sale uses and what warnings the cashier sees.
steps: Go to Settings > Cashier Settings > Stock at the Register.
Turn on Prevent Negative Inventory to stop overselling.
Turn on expiry alerts and choose how many days before expiry to show a warning.
Choose which stock source to use and how stock is deducted.
Click Save.

title: Choose how a sale uses stock
text: The stock source and deduction method decide which stock is used when a sale is made.
steps: Go to Settings > Cashier Settings > Stock at the Register.
Choose the stock source for sales.
Choose the deduction method, such as FIFO, if available.
Click Save and check the setting before making a sale.
